notes.title: Commando 2 - Final Chapter: Dark Sacrifice of Master Duanshuiliu Now Live!
notes.notes:
This update adds the climactic final battle stage: after defeating the three rockets, players will face Kung Master in his ultimate form!

In a desperate bid to defeat Jack, Kung Master sacrifices his soul to a demon in exchange for terrifying dark powers. This will be your toughest challenge yet—can you stop him? (Tip: Don’t use cheat tools… or else.)

We've also refined the rocket stages from the previous update:
Rockets that have been defeated once will now reappear with smoking arms and only half their original HP, streamlining the game pace and intensifying the action.

notes.title: The Ending for Commando2 is Now Available!
notes.notes:
After 17 long years, this little game finally receives its long-awaited ending. Back then, I thought I’d finish it in a year or two—who would’ve thought 17 years would fly by like this!

The most complex part of the ending, the “Aerial Battle: Triple Rockets” sequence, is now complete. I warmly invite all players to check it out!

Up next are the “Aerial Battle: Demon God” segment, some puzzle-based stages, and a final hidden mystery. These parts are less technically demanding than the rocket sequence, so they should be ready and released soon.

Thank you all for your patience and support. See you in the next update!

notes.title: Commando2 Survival Mode is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Survival Mode introduces a brand-new challenge with the following features:  

1. Three Major Stages – Survival Mode consists of three stages, corresponding to Levels 1–4, 5–8, and 9–12 in the traditional mode.  
2. Weapon Carry Limit – Players can carry up to 16 weapons, but once a weapon runs out of ammo, it will be discarded.  
3. True Survival Challenge – You only have one life. Once you die, the game is over.  
4. Military Budget System – Your score is converted into a military budget, which can be used to upgrade or modify weapons, helping you survive longer on the battlefield.  

You can also create your own Survival Mode Mod and share it with the community!  

This little game has been online for almost half a year—it's time to work on the ending. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Commando2 Workshop Welcomes New Enemy – The Dinosaur Legion!
notes.notes:
The enemy has unleashed prehistoric beasts?! The Commando series introduces a brand-new foe – the Dinosaur Legion! In a desperate attempt to turn the tide of war, the enemy has used sinister technology to resurrect these ancient creatures! Now, players must not only fight against formidable enemies but also rescue these controlled prehistoric giants. A thrilling new challenge awaits!

Update Highlights
1, Dinosaur Invasion – Battlefield Upgraded!
The Dinosaur Legion, originating from our sister title Dino Strike, is bringing an unprecedented combat experience to Commando2! These prehistoric creatures are not only massive in size but also possess unique battle mechanics. Can you survive the hail of bullets while facing these ancient beasts?

2, Exclusive to the Workshop – Challenge Awaits!
These dinosaurs won’t appear in official missions but are exclusive to player-created levels! Head to the Workshop, design your own custom battlefield, and integrate the Dinosaur Legion into your creations. Your creativity is eagerly awaited by countless players!

Finally, a big thank you to all our players for your support! In this new year, I will continue to work hard and live up to your expectations!

notes.title: The Workshop for Commando 2 is Complete! All Levels Are Now Editable!
notes.notes:
Update Notes: 

1. After nearly two months of hard work, we have completed the interface development for all enemies and objects. Now, every element from the original version can be freely edited into any level.  

2. Some objects, such as wooden houses, wooden doors, and transport planes, have new features that allow them to summon a wider variety of enemies compared to the original game.  

3. Each time you edit a section of the map, the original level data for that area will be replaced with your new edits.  

4. Due to time constraints, most enemies and mounts currently lack water detection. So if you see enemies walking on water or elephants gliding across the surface, please don't be surprised! We will decide based on player feedback whether to refine these details or keep them as humorous “quirky bugs.”

notes.title: Thumbnail upload and debug hotkeys added in the Commando2 Steam WorkShop
notes.notes:
The details of this update are as follows:

1. The success of Workshop items heavily relies on having a high-quality thumbnail. This update adds a thumbnail upload feature. The 'Thumbnail' button is located to the left of 'Upload Update.' For players who have already published items in the Workshop, it's time to wake up and update your thumbnails!

2. Added debugging features to facilitate testing your creations in the Workshop: Press Z to display terrain, X to hide terrain, and C to skip levels.

3, Added the preview of the level editing.

notes.title: The Workshop now includes full functionality for configuring weapon and enemies.
notes.notes:
Detailed updates are as follows:  

1. Weapon Firing Rate Configuration
   - The previously incomplete weapon firing adjustment feature is now fully implemented. Players can freely customize weapon firing bullet numbers.  

2. Enhanced Enemy Editing
   - In the previous version, only three standard enemy soldiers could be edited. This update expands the editing capability to include all enemies and hostile mechanisms.  

3. Scrollable Description Box
   - A scroll bar has been added to the description box for player creations, making it easier to view and manage longer content.

We can't wait to see more amazing creations from our community!

notes.title: Optimizations and Fixes for the Workshop in Commando 2
notes.notes:
Update Notes:

1. Enhanced Value Editing  
   Workshop value editing has been improved, allowing direct input via keyboard for easier operation.

2. Fixed Content Overwrite Issue
   Resolved an issue where a player’s creation might be overwritten by another player’s work while editing.

3. Fixed Projectile Offset in Enlarged Mode
   Addressed the projectile offset issue that occurred when the player character was enlarged.

notes.title: Steam Workshop Now Available in Commando 2! Survival Mode Integrated!
notes.notes:
Commando 2 Update Notes:

1. New Steam Workshop System: Players can now edit and publish their own unique game versions in the Workshop. Current customizable features include player abilities, weapon attributes, certain enemy characteristics, and game mode settings. A level editor is also in the works, so eager players can claim their spot early and continue refining their content once the editor is fully developed!

2. Boss Item Drop Adjustment: The rocket in the third phase of the Stage 4 Boss will no longer drop score-boosting items, preventing potential score-farming and ensuring leaderboard fairness.

3. Increased Leaderboard Score Limit: The maximum achievable score on the leaderboard has been raised, giving players even more room to chase high scores!

notes.title: Details optimized for the October 12, 2024 update.
notes.notes:
Yesterday, we launched the achievement system, and I almost got “chased” by players~~~ It turns out the achievements were set way too hard! We’ve now significantly lowered the achievement requirements. For details on how to unlock them, please check the achievement descriptions.

The current 24 achievements are just a preliminary attempt, and there will be more fun achievements coming in future updates. Players are incredibly creative! For example, what do you think of the achievement list proposed by player WhiteNoise? Feel free to share your feedback!

(In levels 2, 6, and 10, destroy the car rushing in to deploy two Japanese officers.)

Knife, Commando Sword, Jet Drill

[First Victory]

[Armor-Piercing Duel]

Commando-P1, Cult Commando, MC5 Defender, Desert Rat

[DEBUG TOOL]
Acquire the Kee-Jerk Terminator.

(Don’t kill any snipers during the first half of levels 2, 5, 6, 9, and 10.)

Commando-P1, Cult Commando, MC5 Defender, Desert Rat

(Use the Dragon Destructor to kill any enemy in Level 1.)

(Kill all German paratroopers while they are still in the air, at a certain distance above the screen.)

notes.title: Upgraded the integration for the entire collection to integrate STEAM features.
notes.notes:
This update is as follows:

1. Game Packaging Update: We have changed the packaging of the entire game collection, which now supports STEAM Achievements and Leaderboards. 24 new achievements have been added to the traditional mode of Commando 2, which can be viewed via the “Achievements” button on the start page. However, you can't just turn on mods and mindlessly raid to complete these achievements!

2. New Survivor Mode Preview: We've added a Survivor Mode Preview to Commando 2 with the following features:
   - The modifier bar will change to 10 gun storage spaces, and instead of bullet boxes, Survivor Mode will offer a variety of weapons for players to pick up, each of which will be discarded when they run out.
   - Many new enemies will be welcomed in the preview levels, so you can meet them first in the first level.
   - Survivor Mode levels will be reorganized and will be interspersed with various mini-achievements for more challenge.

3. Community Feedback Fixes: Based on feedback from the Commando player base, we have fixed many minor issues raised by players, not listed individually, but every detail has been fully optimized.

4. Due to the updated engine, the location of the save file has changed, and you cannot inherit the old save file directly. If you want to inherit the old save file, please start the game once and then quit, so that the new engine will create a new save directory, and then manually move the old save over.
The old save should be located at:

"C:\Users\     YOUR USER NAME     \AppData\Roaming\Macromedia\Flash Player\#SharedObjects\ 
    RANDOM STRING     \localhost\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\CommandoCollection"

If you did it correctly, you should see two folders inside. Copy the “Data” folder inside with *replace* to.

"C:\Users\     YOUR USER NAME     \AppData\Roaming\CommandoCollection\Local Store\#SharedObjects"

Just open the game again and you should see your previous save file. This engine now supports cloud save as well.

notes.title: Details optimized for the September 22, 2024 update (Part 2).
notes.notes:
Commando 2
1. We have enhanced the AI of the Samurai Robot, making its combat performance more flexible and dynamic, with the number of moves increased by 200%. So we fixed the bug that made it look not-so-smart (haha).

At the same time, we'd like to take this opportunity to share the current issues in the game and our future plans:

1. Regarding controller support, achievement system, and Steam Workshop
   After some research, we've confirmed that due to the limitations of the older engine used for this game, we are unable to implement these features. We sincerely apologize for this and deeply appreciate everyone's understanding and patience.

2. Future plans for Commando series
   Initially, we launched 'Commando 2' out of nostalgia for our previous works. The game went live just two weeks after passing the store review, without us having high expectations for its popularity. However, to our surprise, many players still remember and love this game. We are incredibly touched by your continued support and affection. Thanks to this precious opportunity, we have secured some startup funding and plan to develop a brand-new sequel to the Commando series.

We plan to develop the new game using a modern engine, which will allow us to fully support controller operation, the achievement system, and Steam Workshop—key Steam features. We are excited about the future and are immensely grateful to each player who has supported us. Your enthusiasm gives us the motivation to keep moving forward.

As for this old game, it will serve as our testing ground. Whenever we come up with strange and quirky ideas, we'll test them here first. So, the updates for this game will not stop, and there will be more fun content in the future.

Once again, thank you all for your support!

================================================== ==========================

Added on October 2, 2024

Bang, bang, yes, what you heard was a slap in the face. Since this announcement was issued. An enthusiastic guy shared with us the method of making achievements with the old AS2 engine overnight. Then, let’s start the achievement system! It will be deeply integrated with survivor mode. Each achievement will be made into a special mini-game instead of killing 1,000 enemies. See you in the next update!

notes.notes:
Commando 2:

1. Improved the performance of the Thruster Harpoon, increasing its firing rate and ammo count. Reflected enemy bullets can now deal damage to enemies.

2. Fixed an issue where certain enemies could get stuck in abnormal positions after being pushed by the Thruster Harpoon.

3. Adjusted the homing missile trajectory of the final rocket boss in level 4 during its first stage. Players can now perform extreme dodges by jumping to avoid the missile barrage.

4. Reduced the touch area for the God Mode, Fire Boost, and Inf Ammo buttons to lower the chance of accidental activation.

Commando X:

notes.title: New weapon added: Thruster Harpoon, along with a huge samurai boss in Commando 2
notes.notes:
The update is listed below:

Commando 2 Update Log:

1. New Weapon: Thruster Harpoon
   A fun weapon with a unique feature: absolute penetration. It repels enemies, deflects bullets, and operates completely silently.

2. New Mini-Boss: Samurai Robot
   A powerful robotic mini-boss now guards the gate to the fourth level military fortress, ready for players to take on.

3. God Mode Enhancement
   With God mode on, players won't die. They will lose a small amount of health when hit, but their last bit of health will never be depleted.

4. Infi Ammo Improvement
   When Infinite ammo is enabled, weapons can continue firing even after running out of bullets.

5. Compatibility Fixes
   Fixed issues where antivirus software caused the game to fail launching or saving. A prompt will now ask for storage permission when starting the game.

6. New Boss Interaction: Kung Fu Master
   The Kung Fu Master no longer fears the Jet Driller and will counter it with his Spiral Ascension move.

7. Hand Grenade and flame cocktail Fix 
   Resolved an issue where hand grenade and flame cocktail weren’t properly interacting with some steps.

notes.title: 2 new weapons have been added to Commando2, Phoenix Smasher and Dual Poncho-75.
notes.notes:
In response to player feedback, the update includes the following changes:

Commando 2:
1. Addressing the shortage of heavy weapons from level 5 to level 8, the Phoenix Smasher (unlocked at level 6, found in Column E) and the Dual Poncho-75 (unlocked at level 8, found in Column I) have been added. The Phoenix Smasher flies off-screen and returns for a second attack if it misses an enemy; after hitting the ground, it rises into the air and swoops down for a powerful impact. The Dual Poncho-75 fires five bursts in addition to spraying double firepower.
2. Increased the attack power of certain weaker weapons.
3. Optimized the attack animation of the Flame Cocktail and fixed a damage bug.
4. Fixed an issue with the Jet Driller where warheads would continue firing after releasing the left mouse button when switching weapons with full power stored.

Commando X:
1. Increased the max population of allied soldiers and enemy units.
2. Enhanced the combat capabilities of the Allied Forces.
3. Defeating powerful bosses now rewards players with more money.
4. The initial turret level at the start of each level has been increased.
5. The speed of health recovery when near the base has been improved.

notes.title: Optimization for lags with large number of enemies on the same screen.
notes.notes:
This update brings:

Commando 2:
1. Optimization of the frame rate drops caused by a large number of enemies on the screen, along with the addition of “Max number of enemies” and “Max number of enemy bullets” options in the settings. Players can adjust these settings according to their needs, allowing the game to run smoothly even on older computers.

2. Added settings to customize the color and shape of blood, allowing for a more personalized battle experience.

3. The number of minions summoned by the boss now corresponds to the “Normal enemy multiplier".

notes.title: Added the option to set a custom enemy generation multiplier for Commando 2.
notes.notes:
This update brings:

Commando 2:
1, Upon entering the game, on the pause page (press the ESC key or click the Settings button in the upper left corner), you can adjust the generation multipliers for normal enemies, elite enemies, and some of the bosses, as well as choose whether or not to allow the bosses to summon minions. All enemy multipliers can now be set by the player throughout the game. How many times can you challenge? How many times can your computer handle?

Commando 3:
1, Enhanced the damage values of most heavy weapons.

notes.title: Additions have been made to the August 22, 2024 detail optimization.
notes.notes:
This update brings:

Commando 2:
1. Fixed the issue where food with a smaller recovery amount may appear randomly in succession in the pre-boss battle supply.
2. Fixed the bug that caused the life value to be deducted when consuming food with a small recovery amount in a low hp state.
3. Adjusted the position of the pause button to prevent accidental touches.

Commando X:
1. Removed the mechanic of holding down the W button to jump continuously, making the operation consistent with Commando 2, thus reducing the possibility of misuse.
2. Made difficulty balance adjustments.

Commando 3:
1. Removed the mechanic of holding down the W button to jump continuously, making the operation consistent with Commando 2, thus reducing the possibility of misuse.

notes.title: Bug fixes and detail optimizations for Commando 2 and Commando 3.
notes.notes:
This update brings:

Commando 2:
1. Fixed an issue where enemy bombers occasionally failed to be hit.
2. fixed an issue where machine gun bullets fired from enemy armored vehicles were too high to hit the player.
3. fixed the problem that rolling stones occasionally reappear in the second level in normal and hard modes.
4. fixed the problem that the wooden fence inside the cabin in the third level will close automatically again occasionally.
5. fixed an issue in the last level where the laser ball would be skipped if the third section of the rocket was destroyed too quickly.

Commando 3:
1. fixed an issue in the second level where it would occasionally get stuck when getting on the airplane at the end of the first section.
2. fixed an issue where player would occasionally get stuck in the mechanical dog mount when it was destroyed in the second level.

notes.title: Windowed Mode added, optimized the background picture quality of Commando 2.
notes.notes:
This update brings:

1. Added Windowed mode button for the game collection.

2. The map quality of Commando2 has been upgraded from medium quality to best quality, so the graphics are no longer blurry.

3. Dual-wielding machine gun feature returns for Commando 3.

notes.title: Pause Feature For Commando 2, And Weapon Balance, Survivor Mode Preview...
notes.notes:
This update brings:

1. Pause Function: Pause function added for Commando 2 in preparation for the upcoming new Survivor mode, which will be very time-consuming.

2. Weapon Balance Adjustments: Balanced and optimized the power of some guns in Commando 2. By the way, there will be unexpected surprises when using the electric gun underwater.

3. Survivor Mode Preview: A new Survivor Mode Preview has been added, including map unlocking, weapon upgrading and achievement system.

4. Character Differentiation: The male and female of Commando 2 have been differentiated. The male has a stronger physique, while the female possesses more agile movements.

5. Final Level Difficulty Adjustment: Difficulty adjustment has been made to the final level of Commando X.

6. Unified pause menu: During gameplay, all three games can call up the pause menu by pressing the ESC key.

notes.title: Added the flying attribute to the drill weapon, unlocked on level 5.
notes.notes:
This update brings:

1. Drill Weapon Modification:
    - In response to player feedback that the Drill weapon was too weak, we have made the following changes:
        - The Drill weapon is now unlocked at level 5 and renamed Jet Driller.
        - Hold down the left mouse button to activate the drill, and press the jump button to enter Flight Mode. In Flight Mode, players can reach previously inaccessible areas and engage bosses in the air.
        - Press and hold the left mouse button to store energy. When the energy is fully stored, releasing the button will cancel Flight Mode and fire a drill armor-piercing bullet.
        - Due to its large size, the drill weapon can also act as a shield to block some enemy bullets.

2. Weapon Replacement:
    - The default Knife and Pistol can now be directly replaced with a better melee weapon or pistol, without taking up additional item slots.

3. UI Adjustment:
    - You can now use shortcut keys 1-6 to switch weapons directly, and the game UI will update accordingly.
